description: Control read, write and execute access to removable storage devices.

policies.name: CD and DVD: Deny Execute Access
policies.description: Prevents execution of programs from CD and DVD removable storage.

policies.name: CD and DVD: Deny Read Access
policies.description: Prevents read access to CD and DVD removable storage.

policies.name: CD and DVD: Deny Write Access
policies.description: Prevents write access to CD and DVD removable storage.

policies.name: Floppy Drives: Deny Execute Access
policies.description: Prevents execution of programs from floppy drives, including USB floppy drives.

policies.name: Floppy Drives: Deny Read Access
policies.description: Prevents read access to floppy drives, including USB floppy drives.

policies.name: Floppy Drives: Deny Write Access
policies.description: Prevents write access to floppy drives, including USB floppy drives.

policies.name: Removable Disks: Deny Execute Access
policies.description: Prevents execution of programs from removable disks.

policies.name: Removable Disks: Deny Read Access
policies.description: Prevents read access to removable disks.

policies.name: Removable Disks: Deny Write Access
policies.description: Prevents write access to removable disks.

policies.name: All Removable Storage Classes: Deny All Access
policies.description: Denies all access to all removable storage classes. This policy takes precedence over individual removable storage policies.

policies.name: WPD Devices: Deny Read Access
policies.description: Prevents read access to Windows Portable Devices such as phones, media players and similar devices.

policies.name: WPD Devices: Deny Write Access
policies.description: Prevents write access to Windows Portable Devices such as phones, media players and similar devices.
